originalFailure.symptom: Five sessions failed before backing sources were scheduled, with the fixed microphone-capture error; one keyboard/count-in session succeeded.
originalFailure.diagnosis: Audio owner instrumented actual startup callbacks: stable stereo blocks of 128 frames with forward pre-arm frame jumps (3584→4224, 3200→3712, 3584→4224). Error preceded arm and backing playback.
originalFailure.repair: Production accumulator now permits forward pre-arm gaps only. Armed capture continuity, topology, finite-input and exact frame intersection checks remain strict.
originalFailure.testChanges: None between original and affected runs.

fixtures.origin: Independently authored original four-track composition and distinct reference PCM before producer inspection. Target, muted and zero-volume sentinels distinguish source exclusion; audible two-note backing uses a direct scalar sine/envelope oracle.

oracleLimits.wavSampling: Every 37th sample against independently computed full-composition sine/envelope/volume/velocity sum; full frame count and format checked.
oracleLimits.midi: All note events independently decoded at 480 ticks/beat; 250000 microseconds/beat; mute and velocity checks retained.

runtime.runner: Root-owned Playwright 1.63.0 invocation, two workers, Chromium via /usr/bin/chromium, base URL http://127.0.0.1:4306.
runtime.processOwnership: Root owns these browser/server invocations and their cleanup; this receipt writer started no runtime.
runtime.capture: Real AudioContext oscillator at 440 Hz through MediaStreamDestination substituted only for microphone permission/input. Native MediaStream source, production AudioWorklet, transcription, normalization, history, IndexedDB and exports ran unchanged. Silent case uses zero gain.
runtime.observation: BufferSource.start wrapper copies scheduled buffers and timestamps then invokes the original native start unchanged.

scopeLimits: Physical microphone/device latency, acoustic leakage and musical recognition accuracy are not measured. Stream-source buffering is not corrected or shifted.
Exact graph-frame intersection is covered by the separate nine-case worklet suite, not inferred from editor stream latency.
Controlled pagehide/pageshow event dispatch is lifecycle simulation, not a claimed native back-forward cache traversal.
Successful editor persistence was verified through actual completed IndexedDB state and page reload, not a whole-browser process restart in this suite.
Repeated capture on the shared AudioContext is exercised by Stop followed by a new capture and controlled pagehide.
This receipt does not claim the maximum-duration probe, full prior regression suite, CI results, or hardware microphone acceptance.
